data.summary: The validation stage produced 1,000 scored rows with a champion score of 0.998 versus a challenger score of 0.607, yet a high‑severity finding (F‑02) indicates the challenger was trained and assessed on the same rows. Additional medium‑severity findings flag approval‑rate disparity by age band (F‑01) and the challenger’s use of age and personal status/sex (F‑03).
reasons: High‑severity finding that the challenger was trained and evaluated on the same data set, compromising model integrity.
Medium‑severity findings reveal potential bias and inappropriate feature usage that warrant further investigation.
